title: Concept: Dependency content changes whenever the branch moves
description: Cargo.toml declares a git dependency pinned to a branch name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a git dependency pinned to a branch name.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a git dependency pinned to a branch name.
